in_marathi.name: Eshanya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Ishana's boon
in_marathi.long_meaning: Eshanya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Ishana’, meaning the lord or the ruler, Eshanya is a name that signifies the blessings of the goddess. It is believed that the name brings prosperity and good fortune to the bearer. This name is also associated with the goddess Durga and is believed to bestow strength, courage, and wisdom.
